name: LEDA 2229803 (Hubble)
blurb: LEDA 2229803, a galaxy thought to lie nearby, seen by Hubble.
label: leda2229803-hubble
story: Hubble paused here for a quick snapshot in a survey of every galaxy thought to lie close to us that it had not yet observed. Picking out individual stars, down below the brightest red giants, lets astronomers measure how far away the galaxy is and read the ages of its stars.

claims.text: LEDA 2229803 (LEDA-2229803) is a target of Hubble program 18070
The program surveys galaxies thought to lie nearby that Hubble had not yet observed
Resolving stars below the tip of the red giant branch gives distances
PGC 2229803 is at the pointing position
